name: security
description: Stack-agnostic security toolkit for Claude Code — a suite of skill-cybersecurity-* skills: -general (OWASP Top 10:2025 code scan), -supply-chain (SCA/dependencies), -secret-scan (secrets + git history), -container-iac (Docker/K8s/Terraform), -threat-model (STRIDE design-level). All produce risk-scored, remediation-focused reports.
